analysis.onsets: FFT-derived positive spectral flux with peak picking
analysis.bands: mix only: spectral flux over 64-band mel split into low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >2000 Hz
analysis.loudness: 50ms-smoothed RMS peaks, relative amplitude; not perceptual LUFS
analysis.activity: RMS rising gate at .2 of p95 with .1 release and 250ms refractory
analysis.alignment: same Redline export folder; full-mix hash verified; no manually applied alignment offset
analysis.beatGrid: MIDI tempo map used only for subdivisions; triggers come from audio analysis
